name: blink_led
description: Blink an LED connected to a Raspberry Pi GPIO pin. Turn it on for one second, then off.

pin.description: BCM GPIO pin number of the LED.

name: move_robot
description: Move the robot in the given direction for the given amount of time

direction.description: The direction to move the robot. Left, Right, Forward, Backward, Stop are accepted

mvtime.description: The amount of time the robot moves in the given direction.
